findings.title: Regularly Scheduled Pop-Ups Canceled for the Remainder of 2026 — Eau Claire
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Due to continued logistical issues with our parking lot, Feed My People will be canceling all remaining regularly scheduled pop-up food distributions
findings.summary: Feed My People Food Bank announced cancellation of all remaining regularly scheduled pop-up food distributions at its Eau Claire food-bank location for the remainder of 2026 because of parking-lot logistical issues. Other communities' pop-ups are unaffected, and the provider says it remains available for emergency pop-ups as needed. This is a major local access reduction, not a systemwide shutdown.
findings.scope: Eau Claire food-bank site only; remaining scheduled pop-ups through December 31, 2026
affected_groups: People relying on scheduled free pop-up food distributions at Feed My People's Eau Claire site
